subject: Analyze YOLOv8 vs YOLOv10 backbone difference and produce change plan
description: Compare yolov8.yaml and yolov10n.yaml backbone sections. Verify SCDown and PSA modules are registered in the model build path. Produce a change_plan artifact with the minimum YAML change needed to swap the backbone while keeping the YOLOv8 head/neck references valid.

todos.content: Read ultralytics/cfg/models/v8/yolov8.yaml and ultralytics/cfg/models/v10/yolov10n.yaml. Compare backbone sections layer by layer. Identify exact differences: layer types at each index, channel counts, and the additional PSA layer in YOLOv10.

todos.activeForm: Verify SCDown and PSA module availability
todos.content: Verify that SCDown and PSA modules are importable in ultralytics/nn/modules/__init__.py and parseable by parse_model in ultralytics/nn/tasks.py. Confirm these modules will resolve at build time.

Produce a change_plan artifact specifying: (1) exact lines to replace in ultralytics/cfg/models/v8/yolov8.yaml backbone section, (2) confirmation that YOLOv8 head references [4, 6, 9] remain valid with the YOLOv10 backbone (11 layers ending at index 10), (3) no changes needed to the head section. Artifact must include file_target, changes array, and verification_notes.
